ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (beige/white) central surface area (approx. 90%) bounded by high-contrast low-intensity (black) pixel distribution at the trailing edge and tips (approx. 10%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity perimeter band along the trailing edge; isolated black hook-shaped cluster (approx. 20px radius) in the medial-proximal region of the right lobe; dual punctate black clusters adjacent to the median notch apex.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated 70-degree pixel-calculated aperture and significant vertical depth relative to the lobar baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations concentrated at the distal tips; irregular undulating peaks and valleys along the mid-trailing edge of both lobes with visible micro-notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward concave curvature originating from the median notch, terminating in dorsally-oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized white high-intensity clusters embedded within the black-pigmented distal region of the right fluke tip, consistent with barnacle scar morphology.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Complex network of unaligned high-intensity curvilinear and linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated in the central and outer quadrants of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent healed linear rake marks on the right lobe; irregular traumatic edge loss (chips/notches) on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique semi-circular black pigment marking located in the mid-lower quadrant of the right lobe; mottled white/black transition zone at the extreme right tip.
